Pose - Villain Reveal Stance.description:
🕴️ Pose: Villain Reveal Stance
A dramatic turn or reveal — half-shadowed, looking over a shoulder, or framed for maximum sinister impact.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Villain Reveal Stance.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, square the shoulders, lift the chin slightly, open the chest, and hold frame-visible hands relaxed at the sides or spread with open palms. Keep the pose controlled rather than enlarging the subject beyond the selected frame. Female: the chest opens, chin lifting on a long neck. Male: shoulders square, chin lifting on a set neck. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own reveal.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
